transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this huddle. As you all know, Riverside Urgent Care Clinic has requested an emergency blood-product reserve to support patients before transfer to our main hospital. The reserve would be stored on-site at Riverside and replenished through our blood bank. Currently, Riverside has no blood products assigned to its inventory, so if we approve this, we'd be building this from the ground up. Before I make a final decision, I want to walk through the plan with all of you — transfusion medicine, lab operations, courier services, and nursing education — to make sure we've addressed safety, logistics, and training. Let's start with transfusion medicine: can you walk us through what products are being requested and the clinical justification?
